name: VPN Switch
author: Shawnicsc
description: Switch VPNs and proxies from the Omarchy bar. Non-conflicting providers can stay on together, and installed software is auto-discovered.

barWidget.description: Toggle UniVPN, Tailscale, FlClash, Clash Verge, Mihomo, sing-box and more. Conflict-aware, with automatic discovery of installed VPN/proxy apps.
